steps.label: node 0 starts an election

stage.title: Phase 1 · ballot 1.0
stage.about: Prepare and Promise. The proposer asks the acceptors to promise its ballot. It needs promises from a quorum.

steps.says: Node 0 starts an election. Node 0 wants to lead at ballot 1.0. It starts Phase 1.
notes: Node 0's election timeout fires. It waited long enough without hearing from a leader. A timeout is not a safety decision. A timeout costs one round and nothing more.
Node 0 becomes a candidate at ballot 1.0: it wants the whole log suffix.
Node 0 raises its durable promise from 0.0 to 1.0. The promise is durable before anything leaves.
Node 0 campaigns at ballot 1.0. It sends one Prepare to 2 peers, and it claims every slot from 0 at once. Phase 1 asks about no value. It asks what the acceptors have already accepted.

Node 0 asks 2 peers for any slot from 0 it may have missed. It does not claim to be behind. A decision reaches a follower only as a commit watermark. A watermark that it did not receive looks the same as a watermark that was never set.

steps.label: Prepare 1.0

stage.title: Phase 1 · ballot 1.0
stage.about: Prepare and Promise. The proposer asks the acceptors to promise its ballot. It needs promises from a quorum.

steps.says: Node 1 promises ballot 1.0. From now on, it refuses every lower ballot.
notes: Node 1 receives Prepare 1.0 for every slot from 0. Its promise was 0.0. It holds 0 accepted records to report.
Node 1 raises its durable promise from 0.0 to 1.0, and reports what it accepted: nothing. Every ballot below 1.0 is fenced out here from now on.
steps.voice: I want to be the leader with ballot 1.0. Promise that you will not accept a lower ballot from slot 0 on, and tell me your votes.

steps.label: Prepare 1.0

stage.title: Phase 1 · ballot 1.0
stage.about: Prepare and Promise. The proposer asks the acceptors to promise its ballot. It needs promises from a quorum.

steps.says: Node 2 promises ballot 1.0. From now on, it refuses every lower ballot.
notes: Node 2 receives Prepare 1.0 for every slot from 0. Its promise was 0.0. It holds 0 accepted records to report.
Node 2 raises its durable promise from 0.0 to 1.0, and reports what it accepted: nothing. Every ballot below 1.0 is fenced out here from now on.
steps.voice: I want to be the leader with ballot 1.0. Promise that you will not accept a lower ballot from slot 0 on, and tell me your votes.

steps.label: CatchUpRequest

stage.title: Phase 1 · ballot 1.0
stage.about: Prepare and Promise. The proposer asks the acceptors to promise its ballot. It needs promises from a quorum.

steps.says: Node 0 asks Node 1 for the chosen slots that Node 0 does not have yet.
notes: Node 1 receives a catch-up request from node 0: it is missing everything from slot 0.
steps.voice: I am behind. Send me the chosen values from slot 0 on.

steps.label: Promise 1.0

stage.title: Phase 1 · ballot 1.0
stage.about: Prepare and Promise. The proposer asks the acceptors to promise its ballot. It needs promises from a quorum.

steps.says: Node 0 gets a promise for ballot 1.0 from Node 1. Node 0 has promises from a majority of the nodes, so Phase 1 is done. It is now the leader at ballot 1.0.

stage.title: Phase 1 · ballot 1.0
stage.about: Prepare and Promise. The proposer asks the acceptors to promise its ballot. It needs promises from a quorum.

steps.label: the client writes alpha

stage.title: Phase 2 · ballot 1.0
stage.about: Accept and Accepted. The proposer asks the acceptors to vote for one value. When a quorum votes for it, the value is chosen.

steps.says: The client writes alpha.

Node 0 records slot 0 = alpha at ballot 1.0. The vote is durable before the Accepted that reports it leaves.
Node 0 proposes alpha for slot 0 at ballot 1.0, to 2 acceptors. No second Phase 1 is needed. The ballot it holds already covers the whole log suffix.

steps.label: Accept 1.0 · slot 0

stage.title: Phase 2 · ballot 1.0
stage.about: Accept and Accepted. The proposer asks the acceptors to vote for one value. When a quorum votes for it, the value is chosen.

steps.says: Node 1 votes for alpha in slot 0 at ballot 1.0.
notes: Node 1 receives Accept 1.0 for slot 0, carrying alpha. Its promise was 1.0. It holds nothing at slot 0.
Node 1 records slot 0 = alpha at ballot 1.0. The vote is durable before the Accepted that reports it leaves.
steps.voice: Please vote for alpha in slot 0 at ballot 1.0.

stage.about: Accept and Accepted. The proposer asks the acceptors to vote for one value. When a quorum votes for it, the value is chosen.

steps.says: Node 0 gets a vote from Node 1. A majority of the acceptors voted for it, so slot 0 = alpha is chosen. No later ballot can change it.
notes: Node 0 receives an Accepted for slot 0 at 1.0 from node 1. Its round for that slot held 1 vote before this one.

stage.about: Accept and Accepted. The proposer asks the acceptors to vote for one value. When a quorum votes for it, the value is chosen.

Node 1 learns that slot 0 is chosen as alpha at ballot 1.0.

steps.voice: Slot 0 is chosen: alpha.

stage.about: The leader tells the other nodes which value is chosen.

steps.says: Node 2 learns that slot 0 = alpha is chosen.
notes: Node 2 receives a Commit: slot 0 is chosen as alpha at ballot 1.0. It held alpha at 1.0 there.

steps.label: node 0 hands the leadership to node 1

stage.title: Hand-off
stage.about: The leader gives its ballot to the next leader. The next leader does not run Phase 1.

steps.says: Node 0 hands the leadership to node 1. Node 0 is not the leader now.
notes: Node 0 hands ballot 1.0 to node 1, and it stops leading inside the same call, before the message exists. It sends the frontier: slot 1 is the next free slot. It also sends the tail below the frontier: 0 slots already chosen, 0 slots still in flight. The two parts cover the whole range. The successor can therefore skip Phase 1 and still know every slot below the frontier.
Node 0 becomes a follower again. Its rounds are volatile, so they go with the leadership. Nobody re-sends what it had in flight.

steps.label: Relinquish 1.0

stage.title: Hand-off
stage.about: The leader gives its ballot to the next leader. The next leader does not run Phase 1.

steps.says: Node 1 takes over ballot 1.0 from Node 0. It does not run Phase 1. Node 1 is now the leader at ballot 1.0.
notes: Node 1 receives a hand-off from node 0. It carries ballot 1.0, the frontier at slot 1, and the tail below the frontier: 0 slots already chosen and 0 slots still in flight. Its own promise was 1.0.

Node 1 takes ballot 1.0 over from node 0. It runs no Phase 1 of its own. Node 0 already holds the promises for 1.0, and it told node 1 where the frontier is and what sits below it. That is the gain: a leader change without a round trip.
steps.voice: I stop being the leader. Take my ballot 1.0 and go on from slot 1. You do not need Phase 1.

steps.label: node 0 crashes

stage.title: Phase 1 · ballot 2.1
stage.about: Prepare and Promise. The proposer asks the acceptors to promise its ballot. It needs promises from a quorum.

steps.says: Node 0 crashes. The disk of Node 0 keeps its promise and its votes. It forgets the rest.
notes: Node 0 crashes. Its disk keeps promise 1.0 and 1 accepted record. Its role, its open rounds, its read rounds and its election timer are gone. notes: Node 2 receives Accept 2.1 for slot 1, carrying bravo. Its promise was 2.1. It holds nothing at slot 1.
Node 2 records slot 1 = bravo at ballot 2.1. The vote is durable before the Accepted that reports it leaves.
steps.voice: Please vote for bravo in slot 1 at ballot 2.1.

steps.label: Accepted 2.1 · slot 1

stage.title: Phase 2 · ballot 2.1
stage.about: Accept and Accepted. The proposer asks the acceptors to vote for one value. When a quorum votes for it, the value is chosen.

steps.says: Node 1 gets a vote from Node 2. A majority of the acceptors voted for it, so slot 1 = bravo is chosen. No later ballot can change it.
notes: Node 1 receives an Accepted for slot 1 at 2.1 from node 2. Its round for that slot held 1 vote before this one.
Slot 1 is chosen. 2 of the 3 acceptors voted for bravo at ballot 2.1. A Phase-2 quorum here is 2 of 3. This decision is final. No later ballot can decide this slot differently.
Node 1 applies slot 1 = bravo. Its contiguous prefix now ends at slot 1.
steps.voice: I voted for your value in slot 1 at ballot 2.1. It is on my disk.

steps.label: Commit 2.1 · slot 1

stage.title: Commit
stage.about: The leader tells the other nodes which value is chosen.

steps.says: The Commit from Node 1 to Node 0 is lost. Node 0 does not get it.
notes: Commit slot 1 = bravo at 2.1 is lost. The protocol must treat a lost message and a partition the same way.
steps.voice: Slot 1 is chosen: bravo.

steps.label: Commit 2.1 · slot 1

stage.title: Commit
stage.about: The leader tells the other nodes which value is chosen.

steps.says: Node 2 learns that slot 1 = bravo is chosen.
notes: Node 2 receives a Commit: slot 1 is chosen as bravo at ballot 2.1. It held bravo at 2.1 there.
Node 2 learns that slot 1 is chosen as bravo at ballot 2.1.
Node 2 applies slot 1 = bravo. Its contiguous prefix now ends at slot 1.
steps.voice: Slot 1 is chosen: bravo.

scenarios.outcome: Nodes 1, 2 know: slot 0 = alpha, slot 1 = bravo.
